apply_max_pool2d: apply 2D max pooling over an input tensor with configurable kernel size, stride, and padding
run_max_pool2d_backward: run the backward pass for max_pool2d using computed indices to reconstruct gradient blocks
apply_adaptive_avg_pool2d: apply 2D adaptive average pooling to resize an input tensor to a specified output size
apply_adaptive_max_pool2d: apply 2D adaptive max pooling to resize an input tensor to a specified output size
compute_pooling_output_shape: compute the output shape along a single dimension given kernel size, padding, stride, and dilation
